mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courtship_likes(id, from_user_id, to_user_id, message, matched) VALUES(#{id}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{message}, #{matched})
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, message, matched, created_at FROM courtship_likes WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE courtship_likes SET matched = #{matched} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.to_user_id, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS to_nickname, u.avatar_url AS to_avatar_url, l.message, l.matched, l.created_at FROM courtship_likes l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.to_user_id LEFT JOIN courtship_profiles p ON p.user_id = l.to_user_id WHERE l.from_user_id = #{userId} AND l.matched = FALSE ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
